Title: Pahadi Gud (Jaggery)
Body (HTML):
Traditional unrefined jaggery made from clean sugarcane juice, slowly wood-boiled and blended with local herbs, seeds, and premium dry fruits.

A mineral-rich, completely natural alternative to white sugar. Sourced from the foothills of the Himalayas, our jaggery retains all natural molasses, vitamins, and minerals, crafted using ancestral sugarcane clarification methods.

Key Highlights:

  • Unrefined & Pure: No chemical clarifying agents or sulfur used.
  • Himalayan Herbs & Premium Blends: Infused with traditional herbs, premium nuts, and seeds.
  • Healthy Sweetener: Rich in iron, magnesium, and essential nutrients.
